messages:
Asha (runtime): FYI following the postmortem, let's turn the remediation items into a repeatable cadence. main problems: slow leak in shard KV cache, fragmentation, and intermittent OOMs under certain seq len patterns.
Miguel: +1. can we split into immediate guards vs medium-term profiling tasks?
Priya: Immediate: add soft eviction + per-shard hard cap. I can own the eviction policy change. Target: EOW. @Miguel can you add tests? :thumbsup:
Miguel: Yep. I'll add unit tests and a small load test. ETA Wed.
Jin: For medium term we should run an end-to-end leak profile with the new allocator flags and slab sampling. I can run the profiler and collect pprof traces.
Asha (runtime): Jin, please collect three runs (cold, warm, sustained 10m) and upload to the postmortem ticket. Reference command:
```
pprof -http=localhost:8080 /srv/runtime/proc -symbolize=none --alloc_space
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/debug/pprof/heap > heap.pprof
```
Miguel: noted. also let's add an automated job in CI that validates shard residency doesn't grow > 10% after 5m under synthetic load. I'll file a ticket.
Priya: Ownership summary then: Priya -> eviction + rate limits; Miguel -> tests and CI job; Jin -> profiler and trace uploads; Sam (oncall) -> run canary and monitor for 48h after deploy.
Sam (oncall): Happy to run the canary. I'll also add an alert tweak: raise the KV residency trend alert sensitivity so we get earlier warnings.
Asha (runtime): Timeline: soft fixes (eviction + alert tweak) by EOW, canary next Tue, profiling and GC tuning next sprint (2w). Anyone opposed?
Miguel: fine. I'll link PRs to the postmortem and add changelog notes.
Jin: One more item: fragmentation metric we discussed needs to be added to telemetry (resident_chunks vs alloc_chunks). I'll prototype a query and share it here.
Priya: Add a rollback playbook note: if canary shows >5% error or memory drift >20% revert to previous canary image and open an immediate incident.
ops-bot: Incident runbook snippet added to ticket #INF-842 in case of canary regression.
Asha (runtime): Great. Next check-in Friday 10am PT. I'll update the postmortem with owners/times and mark actions as 'in-progress'. Thanks all. :rocket:
